Young Goldendoodle Mix is Searching For a New Family After Owner Could No Longer Care For Him
Meet Buddy, an energetic and affectionate Goldendoodle mix who has found himself in need of a new family after an unfortunate life change. At almost three years old and weighing approximately 60 pounds, Buddy was recently surrendered to Great Dog Rescue New England by his previous owner for no fault of his own. According to the rescue, “Buddy was surrendered to us in Tennessee after his previous family could no longer care for him due to their declining health.” Since then, Buddy has been placed with a loving foster family where he can wait in safety and comfort during this transition period.

Homeless, Black, transgender parents in Denver denied custody of seven children
A family made up of seven children and Black and transgender parents in Denver has been ripped apart by the Department of Human Services, according to a statement from Housekeys Action Network Denver, or HAND. The children were taken from their parents, Rehema Cranmer, and her partner, who is transgender, in June, HAND reported in a statement. HAND believes the family was discriminated against in court because the parents are homeless and one of them is transgender., the statement said “The testimony from the prosecution spoke clearly to rich white expectations of how families should live and educate their kids, presuming if a family can’t afford housing and must live in a van, that they should not be allowed to have kids period. And presuming that a Black and transgender family definitely cannot be trusted to care for their kids or much less homeschool them.”

Meet The Two 10-Week-Old Puppy Brothers Still Looking For Love After Siblings Already Adopted
Get ready to meet a pair of puppy brothers who are looking for the forever families who will give them their second chance at life. According to Great Dog Rescue New England (GDRNE), a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, Furball Fury and Sir Waggington Windsor are two adorable puppy brothers who were less than 7 weeks old when they were “found as strays in Mississippi and are looking for their forever families,” explains the local rescue. Once taken into their care, the rescue was able to place the Windsor brothers, as well as their other siblings found with them, in loving foster homes. Now, Furball Fury and Sir Waggington are the last of the siblings still without a forever home.

Young Dog Who Was Found Alone at Local Truck Stop is Searching For Family
Get ready to meet Roscoe, a charming young Hound pup who is eagerly awaiting his forever home. While his exact beginnings are unknown, until recently, Roscoe was living as a stray on the streets of Tennessee. According to the local rescue that took him in, Great Dog Rescue New England (GDRNE), “This handsome guy was found as a stray at a local truck stop in Tennessee. No one ever came forward to claim him, and he is happy, healthy, and looking for his forever family!” Thanks to the rescue, Roscoe now has the opportunity to live in safety and comfort with a loving foster family provided to him, while he awaits his future forever family.
